About Aster

Aster is a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures and spot trading, mainly on BNB Chain. ASTER is its governance and utility token.

Where this ASTER price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (ASTER-USD), Binance (ASTER/USDT) and Kraken (ASTER/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 1.70B ASTER (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
